name: Jide Wo
source:
The protagonist Cheng Hui often had strange dreams, dreaming that he had killed the woman he called his sister... He also felt that his daily life was full of disharmony. One day, he was involved in a weird and familiar massacre. The truth has come to chase him. Its chase is cold and cruel, just like a hunter chasing its prey.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1512240/_/]Steam[/url]]
